name: hackforge
description: AI code generation platform — Next.js frontend, Express API, MongoDB, and Groq LLM inference.
author: Yugank Fatehpuria

comments.layout: This is a convenience wrapper only. frontend/ and backend/ are fully independent npm packages with their own lockfiles, which is what lets Vercel and Render each build one directory without the other. Deliberately NOT npm workspaces: workspaces hoist into a root node_modules, which those platforms' per-directory installs cannot see.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix backend test
